title: Smart Watering
description: Water deeply but less often. Let the top inch of soil dry before watering again — consistency keeps roots strong and healthy.

title: Perfect Light Balance
description: Most houseplants love bright, indirect sunlight. Avoid harsh midday rays to prevent leaf burn and fading colors.

title: Feed for Growth
description: Use organic or liquid fertilizer every 3–4 weeks during the growing season. Skip feeding in winter when growth slows down.

title: Shape & Prune
description: Trim dead or leggy stems regularly. Pruning encourages fuller growth and helps your plant maintain its natural shape.

title: Happy Repotting
description: Repot once a year into a slightly larger pot with fresh soil. This gives your plant room to grow and breathe.
